status: EXPLORATORY; prior Jaaks exposure includes HD and E
read_order: drug annotations and public knowledge only; then metadata/model freeze; then response columns
target: confirmed discoveries under original P2, fp=30, M=ceil(menu/5), original tie-breaking
primary: all HD history, existing 61-line E, orientation means are not independent replicates
secondary: 4 and 8 HD lines per tissue; seeds 11,23,47; average seeds within each evaluation line
features: 65 drug metadata records; HGNC exact or unambiguous alias only; no cell-state or outcome knowledge edges
network: directed signed referenced human gene-gene edges; remove benchmark references and conflicting signs; outgoing row-L1 normalisation; separate seed, protein1hop, protein2hop and terminal TF blocks, weights 1,.5,.25,.25
network_meaning: signed topology signatures; drug intervention action sign is unknown; not a causal dynamics model
drug_kernels: ID; .5 ID+.5 annotation; .5 ID+.25 annotation+.25 network; matched covered-drug permutation of network (seed20261004); all normalised to unit diagonal
annotation_kernel: equal target-token cosine and pathway-token cosine; ambiguous targets stay tokens
pair_kernel: half symmetric additive kernel plus half symmetric tensor-product interaction kernel; each unit diagonal
training: weighted kernel ridge on history mean of binary orientation calls, centred on pooled mean, ridge=2, predict clipped[0,1]
selection: each method separately selects blend with C_mean from [0,.25,.5], maximal total HD leave-one-line-out confirmed yield, ties choose smaller blend; shared across tissues; no E tuning
simple_control: also choose strongest of original six simple ranks on HD for each regime, original ordered tie-break
verification: all knowledge arms retain C_mean verification score; only first-screen scores change
inference: paired tissue-stratified line bootstrap 10000; network contrasts also line-by-pair sensitivity 5000; seeds and orientations averaged within line; conditional on fixed fitted histories; no selection-uncertainty or family-wise significance claim
scope: known drugs/pairs in new cell lines, not new-drug or new-pair or independent prospective generalisation
promotion: no production replacement based on exposed Jaaks; require positive value over selected simple, ID, annotation and shuffled controls before larger work
